scope: Additive primary-source audit of Friendly Challenge Hero modifiers. It changes no standard Home Village catalogue value or Core behavior.
game_version: The support page was consulted on 2026-09-21 and provides no client build identifier. The immutable 2026-09-17 standard Home Village reference remains unchanged.

sources.title: Friendly Challenges
facts: Friendly Challenge Battle Modifiers include separate Esport and Legend tiers.
Those optional tiers define defending-Hero hitpoint and damage modifiers.
The page does not publish ordinary Home Village Hero Banner patrol, targeting, return, respawn, collision, or tick-order behavior.
sources.limitations: The source is explicitly scoped to optional Friendly Challenge Battle Modifiers. It does not define the standard battle contract targeted by this project.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply Friendly Challenge Hero modifiers to standard Home Village battles.
rejected_inferences.reason: The source scopes the modifiers to named optional Friendly Challenge tiers, not ordinary battles.

rejected_inferences.rule: Infer a standard Hero Banner defensive contract from the existence of challenge modifiers.
rejected_inferences.reason: The page supplies no patrol, acquisition, pursuit, return, respawn, collision, or deterministic timing values.

conclusion: The newly consulted primary source adds mode-scoped modifier evidence only. It does not change the standard Home Village Core contract or resolve the existing Hero Banner defense gap.
